sloka: दत्ता मात्रा महाभागा नक्षत्रे भगदैवते ।कुतदारास्तु ते राम सुकेशतनयास्तदा ।। ७.५.३४ ॥
transliteration: dattā mātrā mahābhāgā nakṣatre bhagadaivate ।kutadārāstu te rāma sukeśatanayāstadā ।। 7.5.34 ॥

translations.english: O greatly fortunate Rama, those sons of Sukesha then indeed took wives, given by their mother in the constellation presided over by Bhaga.
